text:
noah: sketching a "review-lane" concept for autofallbacks: sampled hits go into a lightweight inbox (sample vault) with a computed severity score so ops can triage fast. want quick feedback on API + UX.

tess: love the severity score idea. how computed?

ahmed: suggest severity = weighted(sum(trigger_weight, latency_norm, error_freq, user_impact_hint)). keep formula visible and editable per-rollout.

noah: UX: card shows severity badge (low/med/high), trigger labels, model-variant, route, cluster id, and 2-line redacted excerpt. click expands to decision trace + metric sparkline.

tess: privacy: redact by default. provide an ephemeral de-redact token that logs who asked and why. store full payload only in encrypted vault with `audit.read` perms.

ahmed: sampling strategy: confidence-weighted sampling. if a classifier is >90% sure of a model_error, increase sampling prob for that class. otherwise use base sample_rate. helps focus on important failures.

noah: retention tiers: default=7d, long-tail=90d for enterprise. surface storage estimate and per-tenant budget cap in the rollout config.

tess: operator actions needed: accept-suggested-fix (apply to rollout rules), queue-for-postmortem, dismiss, pin-to-issue. actions should be auditable.

ahmed: add "apply suggestion" hook: when operator accepts, it creates a proposed rule change (e.g., bump timeout, switch variant) which goes through a canary rollout preview before applying. keep human-in-loop.

noah: clustering: fuzzy-dedupe using n-gram + simhash. show representative item + count. cluster window configurable (default 12h). bulk actions operate on cluster.

tess: UI affordance: inline mini-playback (masked) that replays the request through a non-production replica model for quick sanity-check. must be disabled for PII-sensitive tenants.

ahmed: API surface sketch:
GET /rollouts/{id}/review-lane?page=&cluster=&severity=&filter=
POST /rollouts/{id}/review-lane/{sample_id}/action {action, operator, note}
POST /rollouts/{id}/review-lane/bulk {cluster_id, action}

noah: permission model: review.view, review.annotate, review.apply-suggested. de-redact requires review.audit -> generates audit-bot entry.

tess: noise control: adaptive cap per-route: if trigger_rate > cap, downsample using reservoir sampling + exponential decay so we don't miss signal while bounding storage. display estimated false-negative rate.

ahmed: telemetry: emit metrics: samples.ingested, avg_severity, clusters.created, operator_actions, de_redacts. hook these into rollout dashboard so PMs can see triage load.

audit-bot: note: any config enabling full payload retention must record tenant acceptance of data retention SLA.

noah: next steps: I'll wire a lightweight mock for the console and severity formula editor. @ahmed will prototype confidence-weighted sampling runtime shim. @tess will draft privacy copy and de-redaction flow. target: demo in 1 sprint.

tess: ack, will include wording for de-redaction justification and required fields.

ahmed: starting spike tomorrow AM. will simulate traffic and measure ingest p95 with 0.5% base + boosted high-confidence sampling.

audit-bot: saved action: assign: noah, ahmed, tess. migration note: enabling review-lane creates samples table; expect short lock window.
